frozen_note: Thresholds, arm definitions and the held-out window rule are frozen before any arm is run on held-out footage. Change only via a new frozen_at entry recorded BEFORE results are seen.
detections: One frozen GPU detect run per window (P1, approval required). Every arm and ablation replays the same detections_raw.

B1.role: B0 + persistent player IDs (ByteTrack / OC-SORT port)

C.role: hybrid four-state director: ball_tracked / ball_missing / uncertain / stoppage_restart

counterattack_definition: possession change to attacking third within 4 s (9v9 on 7v7-size pitch; tightened from 6 s)

development.windows_rule: 3 x 5 min at minutes 10, 25, 40 (shift only to avoid half-time); sample_02 180 s stays regression-only

held_out.session: Aylestone Rec, bigger pitch, ~10v10 (Johnson; count to verify)
held_out.windows_rule: 3 x 5 min at minutes 10, 25, 40 (shift only to avoid half-time)
rules: first-pass results recorded and published before any tuning
after that Aylestone is development data, not independent

footage.limitations: 2 sessions / 2 venues: ranks arms and detects transfer failure; does not accept the MVP. Acceptance needs 4-5 sessions including adjacent matches.
